blocks.prompt: 4 (a) Write down the \(n\)th term of the sequence: \(7, 13, 19, 25, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein aisa ek formula \(a_n\) chahiye jo \(n = 1, 2, 3, \ldots\) rakhne par har term de de.
Terms har dafa barabar farq se badal rahe hain. Aisi sequence ka formula hamesha \(a_n = dn + c\) shakal ka hota hai: \(dn\) har qadam par \(d\) jorta hai aur \(c\) ek fixed correction hai jo pehla term theek karta hai.
Plan: pehle farq \(d\), phir pehle term se \(c\), aur aakhir mein kisi doosre term se check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(7, 13, 19, 25, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(n\)th term \(a_n\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: Barabar farq \(d\) ho to \(a_n = dn + c\) likhenge, aur \(n = 1\) rakh kar pehle term se \(c\) nikalenge. Yeh wahi baat hai jo A.P. ke formula \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se aati hai.

Farq (common difference) nikalein
\[13 - 7 = 6,\ 19 - 13 = 6\]
\[25 - 19 = 6\]
Kyun: Har lagataar jore ka farq \(6\) hai. Is liye formula \(a_n = 6n + c\) shakal ka hoga. Farq positive hai kyunke terms barh rahe hain.

Pehle term se \(c\) nikalein
\[6(1) + c = 7\]
\[c = 1\]
\[a_n = 6n + 1\]
Kyun: \(n = 1\) par formula ko pehla term dena chahiye. Is se ek simple equation banti hai jis mein sirf \(c\) unknown hai; dono taraf se wohi number minus kar ke \(c\) mil gaya.

Doosre terms se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 6(2) + 1 = 13 \;\checkmark\]
\[n = 3:\ 6(3) + 1 = 19 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(n = 2\) aur \(n = 3\) rakhe; diye gaye terms hi aaye. Matlab formula poori sequence ke liye sahi hai, sirf pehle term ke liye nahi.

blocks.prompt: 4 (b) Write down the \(n\)th term of the sequence: \(7, 4, 1, -2, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein aisa ek formula \(a_n\) chahiye jo \(n = 1, 2, 3, \ldots\) rakhne par har term de de.
Terms har dafa barabar farq se badal rahe hain. Aisi sequence ka formula hamesha \(a_n = dn + c\) shakal ka hota hai: \(dn\) har qadam par \(d\) jorta hai aur \(c\) ek fixed correction hai jo pehla term theek karta hai.
Plan: pehle farq \(d\), phir pehle term se \(c\), aur aakhir mein kisi doosre term se check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(7, 4, 1, -2, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(n\)th term \(a_n\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: Barabar farq \(d\) ho to \(a_n = dn + c\) likhenge, aur \(n = 1\) rakh kar pehle term se \(c\) nikalenge. Yeh wahi baat hai jo A.P. ke formula \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se aati hai.

Farq (common difference) nikalein
\[4 - 7 = -3,\ 1 - 4 = -3\]
\[-2 - 1 = -3\]
Kyun: Har lagataar jore ka farq \(-3\) hai. Is liye formula \(a_n = -3n + c\) shakal ka hoga. Farq negative hai kyunke terms ghat rahe hain.

Pehle term se \(c\) nikalein
\[-3(1) + c = 7\]
\[c = 10\]
\[a_n = -3n + 10 = 10 - 3n\]
Kyun: \(n = 1\) par formula ko pehla term dena chahiye. Is se ek simple equation banti hai jis mein sirf \(c\) unknown hai; dono taraf se wohi number minus kar ke \(c\) mil gaya.

Doosre terms se tasdeeq
\[n = 2:\ 10 - 6 = 4 \;\checkmark\]
\[n = 4:\ 10 - 12 = -2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(n = 2\) aur \(n = 3\) rakhe; diye gaye terms hi aaye. Matlab formula poori sequence ke liye sahi hai, sirf pehle term ke liye nahi.

blocks.prompt: 4 (c) Write down the \(n\)th term of the sequence: \(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{4}, \frac{1}{5}, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Yahan terms fractions hain aur in ka farq barabar nahi (\(\frac{1}{3} - \frac{1}{2} \ne \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{3}\)), is liye \(dn + c\) wala tareeqa yahan kaam nahi karega.
Behtar yeh hai ke numerator (upar wala number) aur denominator (neeche wala number) ko alag alag dekhein, aur har ek ko position \(n\) se milayein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{3}, \frac{1}{4}, \frac{1}{5}, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(n\)th term \(a_n\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: Numerators ka pattern aur denominators ka pattern alag alag dhoondhenge, phir dono ko jor kar formula banayenge.

Numerators (upar wale numbers)
\[1, 1, 1, 1, \ldots\]
Kyun: Har term ka numerator 1 hai, is liye \(a_n\) ka numerator bhi hamesha 1 hoga; is mein \(n\) aayega hi nahi.

Denominators ko position se milayein
\[n = 1, 2, 3, 4\]
\[\text{bottom} = 2, 3, 4, 5\]
\[\text{bottom} = n + 1\]
Kyun: Ek chhoti table bana lein: position 1 par denominator 2, position 2 par 3, position 3 par 4. Har dafa denominator position se 1 zyada hai, is liye \(n\)th denominator \(n + 1\) hai.
Dhyan dein: \(a_n = \frac{1}{n}\) likhna aam ghalti hai; \(n = 1\) par woh 1 deta hai, \(\frac{1}{2}\) nahi.

Formula likhein aur check karein
\[a_n = \dfrac{1}{n + 1}\]
\[n = 3:\ \dfrac{1}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(n = 3\) rakha to \(\frac{1}{4}\) aaya, jo teesra term hai. Is liye formula sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 4 (d) Write down the \(n\)th term of the sequence: \(-15, -4, 7, 18, \ldots\)
blocks.explanation:
Humein aisa ek formula \(a_n\) chahiye jo \(n = 1, 2, 3, \ldots\) rakhne par har term de de.
Terms har dafa barabar farq se badal rahe hain. Aisi sequence ka formula hamesha \(a_n = dn + c\) shakal ka hota hai: \(dn\) har qadam par \(d\) jorta hai aur \(c\) ek fixed correction hai jo pehla term theek karta hai.
Plan: pehle farq \(d\), phir pehle term se \(c\), aur aakhir mein kisi doosre term se check.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(-15, -4, 7, 18, \ldots\)
Humein find karna hai: \(n\)th term \(a_n\) ka formula.
Tareeqa: Barabar farq \(d\) ho to \(a_n = dn + c\) likhenge, aur \(n = 1\) rakh kar pehle term se \(c\) nikalenge. Yeh wahi baat hai jo A.P. ke formula \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) se aati hai.

Farq (common difference) nikalein
\[-4 - (-15) = 11\]
\[7 - (-4) = 11,\ 18 - 7 = 11\]
Kyun: Har lagataar jore ka farq \(11\) hai. Is liye formula \(a_n = 11n + c\) shakal ka hoga. Farq positive hai kyunke terms barh rahe hain. Dhyan dein: negative number minus karna jama karne jaisa hai: \(-4 - (-15) = -4 + 15 = 11\).

Pehle term se \(c\) nikalein
\[11(1) + c = -15\]
\[c = -26\]
\[a_n = 11n - 26\]
Kyun: \(n = 1\) par formula ko pehla term dena chahiye. Is se ek simple equation banti hai jis mein sirf \(c\) unknown hai; dono taraf se wohi number minus kar ke \(c\) mil gaya.

Doosre terms se tasdeeq
\[n = 3:\ 33 - 26 = 7 \;\checkmark\]
\[n = 4:\ 44 - 26 = 18 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(n = 2\) aur \(n = 3\) rakhe; diye gaye terms hi aaye. Matlab formula poori sequence ke liye sahi hai, sirf pehle term ke liye nahi.
